title: USP Availability
description: Availability schema for the Universal Scheduling Protocol. Defines TimeSlot and Hold objects for querying and reserving bookable time windows.

TimeSlot.title: TimeSlot
TimeSlot.description: A specific, bookable time window for a service. Slots are computed dynamically by the business from schedules, resource calendars, and existing bookings.

id.description: Unique slot identifier, opaque to the platform. Used to reference the slot in hold and booking operations.

service_id.description: The service this slot belongs to.

start.description: RFC 3339 start time of the slot.

end.description: RFC 3339 end time of the slot.

duration.description: ISO 8601 duration of the slot (e.g., PT60M).

state.description: The availability state of the slot. available: has capacity. limited: low remaining capacity. waitlist: fully booked but waitlist enabled.

capacity.description: Present for group and reservation types.

resources.description: Resources available for this slot (e.g., which staff members or rooms are free).

location.description: The specific location for this slot when a service is offered at multiple locations.

pricing.description: Slot-specific pricing that overrides service-level pricing. Used for peak/off-peak or demand-based pricing.

label.description: Optional human-readable note (e.g., Peak hour rate).

Hold.title: Hold
Hold.description: A temporary reservation of a time slot that prevents double-booking during the booking flow. Holds have a short TTL and are automatically released on expiry.

spots.description: Number of spots held. For group and reservation types, this is the number of capacity units reserved.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 expiration time. After this time, the hold is automatically released. Businesses SHOULD set hold TTL between 5 and 10 minutes.

status.description: active: hold is in effect. expired: TTL elapsed. released: explicitly released. converted: successfully converted to a booking.
